Dam Safety Committee Reviews Act Implementation Amid Ageing Infrastructure Concerns

The National Committee on Dam Safety has reviewed the implementation of the Dam Safety Act. This review comes as concerns are raised about the safety risks posed by ageing dams, such as the Meghadri Gedda Dam. The focus is on ensuring the structural integrity and safety protocols for the nation's dams.
